name: Shkola "Idillija"!
source:
Welcome to the «Idyllia School»! This is the place where nothing is wrong! Where everyone is happy!

Find your goals, realise them, fulfil your desires! There is no place more perfect! Our students are happy! 

Feel this «Idyll» with your virgin friend Sumi, a sweet, modest girl who loves to eat terribly! Your maiden friend has a best friend, Miho! A girl who will sweep anyone off their feet! Sports is still a soft word for her. A real volleyball master! Or do you enjoy smart company at the journalism club? Mrs Aiko is waiting for you, exactly YOU in her club! Beautiful and feminine, sporty and smart girl!

The world of «Idyllia» is waiting for you! Come quickly and invite your friends! All are welcome! And afterwards, we'll take care of you.....

This version is indicative. Plot, characters may change depending on your feedback and suggestions!

Translation into English is made by me sometimes with the help of internet translator. Don't judge me harshly. I warned you.

This is my first game made without any skills, so everything and the game is copyrighted and taken from open sources.

Thank you all for your attention!
